title: Sections page
summary: A read-mostly record page with no data lifecycle: the shared title bar (heading, breadcrumb, badges, a primary action and an actions menu that collapses on a phone), docked section tabs in the header, and a two-column pk-detail-layout of your own panels, one section at a time. Name the sections in config.sections ({ id, label, count?, visible? }); each section's panel is a light-DOM child with slot="section-<id>" (the main column) and, optionally, slot="side-<id>" (that section's summary card). The tabs and the layout stay in step both ways; with config.tabParam the chosen section is kept in the address. It loads, saves and validates nothing: a host with a record to edit uses pk-record-page, one with a list beside the record pk-master-detail-page.

props.name: config
props.description: { sections: [{ id, label, count?, visible? }], section?: id (selected, default the first visible), tabParam?: string (keeps the section in the address, for example 'tab'), sidebarFirst?, sidebarTwoUp? (as pk-detail-layout), heading?, breadcrumb?: [{ label, href? }], actions?: [{ key, label, icon?, href?, variant?, disabled?, busy?, hint? }], newAction? (one item of that shape, drawn first as the primary action), actionsCollapse? ('always' | 'phone' | 'tablet' | 'none', one value for the whole bar, default 'phone': an item with an icon folds to the icon alone and its label stays the name) (the first with variant 'primary' is the page's primary action; an action without href fires pk-action), badges: [{ label, variant? }], actionsOverflow: 'never' | 'phone' | 'tablet' | 'always', overflowLabel, homeHref, homeLabel, homeIcon } as on pk-page-header. A section with visible false has no tab and no panel.

props.name: section
props.description: The selected section id. Set it to choose a section from script; it follows the tabs when the reader chooses one.

slots.name: section-<id>
slots.description: The main column of the section with that id in config.sections (for example slot="section-details").

slots.name: side-<id>
slots.description: The summary card beside that section (for example slot="side-details"); a section with none draws no side column.

slots.name: actions
slots.description: Your own actions after those from config.actions (a pk-button, or a pk-dropdown or pk-card-menu: under actionsOverflow its items become rows of the overflow menu).

events.name: pk-action
events.description: A title-bar action (config.actions entry without an href) was clicked.

events.name: pk-section-change
events.description: The reader chose another section (the layout's own event, composed so it reaches this element; cancelable: a cancelled change keeps the old tab).

parts.name: header
parts.description: The shared title bar: a pk-page-shell holding the breadcrumb, badges, actions and the section tabs.

parts.name: tabs
parts.description: The docked section tabs (a pk-tabs in the header); hidden with fewer than two sections.

parts.name: layout
parts.description: The pk-detail-layout around the panels (hide-tabs, tabs-from always: one section shows at a time).

a11y: The tabs are pk-tabs (a real tablist with arrow-key movement); only the chosen section's panel is shown. Give each panel's content its own headings; the page title is the level-1 heading.
